title: RBC | The Power of "Believe"
description: RBC is committing $100 million over five years to support a variety of initiatives, including after school programs, children's mental health and amateur sports. See the impact of our pledge at http://www.youtube.com/user/RBC

asr.full_text: believe, a powerful little word one that brings people together. It has the power to change how we feel and move us to invest in things we believe in and if there's one thing we should all believe in, it's kids because when we believe in kids something magical can happen they start believing themselves believing in themselves.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an RBC corporate message about supporting children and youth through after-school programs, mental health, sports, and related initiatives. The $100 million amount is described as RBC's five-year pledge, not a promised return, investment opportunity, or required payment from viewers. The use of “invest” refers to general support for children and a healthier future, and no request for money, credentials, or financial participation is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an ordinary corporate communication about RBC's business-supported community initiatives and pledge, rather than a reward, investment-return, credential-request, recruitment or paid-guidance mechanism.
